text.en: Pet parents rave about the exceptional dedication and warmth demonstrated by groomers Elif and Judith at SuperGrooms. Reviewers appreciate that the team operates on a one-on-one grooming model, giving full undivided attention to every client. Customers frequently highlight the groomers' calm, soothing manners that put even nervous pets quickly at ease.

title.en: Care for anxious and senior pets

text.en: Reviewers emphasize the salon's gentle approach when handling older dogs, blind pets, and animals with medical sensitivities or prior trauma. Clients note that the team prioritizes comfort over speed, taking pauses and offering constant reassurance during grooming. Owners express relief seeing their typically fearful companions leave happy, relaxed, and wagging.

Customers consistently praise the high aesthetic and technical quality of the haircuts, bath sessions, and nail trims. Multiple owners highlight the groomers' willingness to painstakingly brush through severe coat matting rather than resorting to shaving. Clients appreciate that finished grooms align closely with requested styles while keeping coats healthy.

q.en: Does SuperGrooms work with reactive or fearful dogs?

a.en: Yes, reviewers frequently praise the team's patience with highly anxious, traumatized, or touch-sensitive pets.

q.en: What grooming model does the salon use?

a.en: The salon utilizes a dedicated one-on-one grooming approach to maintain a quiet and low-stress environment.

q.en: Can groomers preserve matted coats without shaving?

a.en: Yes, clients highlight that groomers put in significant effort to brush out matting safely instead of shaving down the coat.

q.en: Where is SuperGrooms located in Toronto?

a.en: The salon is located on College Street, offering an accessible ground-level grooming space for neighborhood pet owners.
